Short summary / CRM notes:
- Company: mid-size multinational insurer with sensitive PII + regulated EU/UK/CA customers. Heavy emphasis on legal/regulatory alignment.
- Primary ask: Private VPC deployment with strict regional controls (EU-only for EU product lines; separate tenant/region for UK; Canada to host Canadian customer data; APAC pilot later).
- Security: must support SSO (IdPs in EU/UK/CA), HSM/KMS integration (Azure Key Vault and AWS KMS acceptable), immutable audit logs forwarded to customer SIEM, retention controls by region.
- Performance: chat & embeddings workloads. Latency targets: 100-200ms token generation for agent flows; embeddings throughput for nightly batch (50k docs/day). Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to pay for residency guarantees.
- POC scope proposed: private VPC in eu-central-1 + optional uk-south region; KMS integration with customer-managed keys; audit log forwarding to Splunk; network peering and strict egress rules; optional on-prem gateway for air-gapped claims environment.
- Quotes / paraphrases: "We cannot store EU citizen data outside EU boundaries for this product line" (Head of Data Protection).
- Risks flagged: legal wants vendor DPA changes; infra wants clear runbook for key rotation and KMS access patterns; ops wants fallback policy (if EU capacity impacted, what is allowed?).
- Action items: SE to provide KMS runbook for both Azure + AWS HSM (done 2026-03-04), AE to get DPA redlines from legal, schedule POC kickoff for EU-only environment once DPA signed.
- Sales note: Potential upsell to Dedicated if POC shows predictable throughput. Optimize module interesting for quantization/batching guidance to reduce token costs.
- Internal: assign infra architect if POC accepted; open security ticket to capture audit log retention SLA.
